script_text: Hold the phone, Aries — Mars is lighting a fire under your chart today! Transiting Mars in Gemini is forming a tense square to your natal Mars in Aries, activating your 3rd House of Communication and sparking restless mental energy. Meanwhile, Venus in Taurus is sextile your natal Mars, bringing a warm, grounding influence to your 7th House of Partnerships and making conversations with lovers feel surprisingly steady. In love, if you're attached, expect a productive talk that clears lingering tension; if single, you'll attract someone who appreciates your directness but also offers calm patience. For career and money, Jupiter in Cancer trines your natal Sun in the 10th House, opening a door to a leadership role or a financial bonus tied to a long‑term project. Watch out for impulsive emails — pause before hitting send, as the Mars square could tempt you to speak too sharply. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
